style: photorealistic documentary photography, natural lighting, realistic people and places, respectful depiction of local cultures

characters.Smart Village Boy: Kenyan boy, twelve years old, dark skin, red cap, yellow T-shirt, short black hair, bright smile
characters.Sonam Wangchuk: Ladakhi engineer in his late fifties, short greying hair, weathered face, wearing a traditional maroon Ladakhi wool robe tied with a sash

scenes.description: Visuals: Smart Village Boy running up a dusty Kenyan hilltop at sunrise, reaching out to spin a large wooden globe on a stand, with mud houses and acacia trees behind him.
scenes.narration: No electricity. No fridge. No running water. Yet villagers around the world keep food cold, light their homes and pull water from the air.
scenes.prompt: Wide shot, 50mm lens, warm sunrise light, Smart Village Boy running up a dusty hill, both hands reaching out to spin a large wooden globe, mud houses and acacia trees in the background.

scenes.description: Visuals: Smart Village Boy standing beside the wooden globe on the Kenyan hilltop at sunrise, pointing at one of five small red pins stuck into it.
scenes.narration: Welcome to Smart Village Boy, where we visit the world's villages for their cleverest ideas. Stay to the end, because hack number five is alive.
scenes.prompt: Medium shot, 50mm lens, warm sunrise light, Smart Village Boy standing beside a large wooden globe, one hand resting on the globe, the other hand holding a small red pin, mud houses and acacia trees in the background.

scenes.description: Visuals: Two farmers in thick woollen clothes standing beside a dry stone irrigation channel in a frozen Himalayan valley in Ladakh, India, on a winter afternoon, with snowy mountains behind.
scenes.narration: High in the Himalayas, the farmers of Ladakh face a cruel problem. Spring is when their crops need water most, and that is exactly when it runs short.
scenes.prompt: Medium shot, 50mm lens, cold winter afternoon light, two Ladakhi farmers in thick woollen clothes standing beside a dry stone irrigation channel, one farmer's hands resting on the stone wall, the other's hands at their sides, snowy mountains in the background.

scenes.description: Visuals: Sonam Wangchuk standing in the snow in a Ladakh valley on a freezing winter night, opening a valve on a pipe as a fountain of water sprays upward and freezes onto a tall cone of ice.
scenes.narration: Engineer Sonam Wangchuk piped meltwater downhill and sprayed it into the freezing air. It froze into a towering cone of ice called an ice stupa.
scenes.prompt: Medium shot, 50mm lens, cold winter night light, Sonam Wangchuk standing in snow, both hands on a valve, water spraying upward, a tall cone of ice behind him, snowy mountains in the background, maroon robe visible under a layer of ice.

scenes.description: Visuals: Smart Village Boy sitting beside the wooden globe on the Kenyan hilltop at sunset, smiling as he looks at the five red pins.
scenes.narration: Five villages, five problems and five brilliant answers. Not one of them needed a big budget.
scenes.prompt: Medium shot, 50mm lens, warm sunset light, Smart Village Boy sitting on a Kenyan hilltop, right hand resting on the wooden globe, left hand holding one of the red pins, bright smile, five red pins stuck in the globe, savannah in the background.

scenes.description: Visuals: Smart Village Boy waving towards the viewer on the Kenyan hilltop at dusk, with the first stars appearing above the village.
scenes.narration: Which hack would you use where you live? Share one from your own village in the comments, and subscribe for more.
scenes.prompt: Medium shot, 50mm lens, warm dusk light, Smart Village Boy standing on a Kenyan hilltop, right hand raised with open palm, left hand at his side, bright smile, savannah and village in the background with first stars appearing in the sky.
